title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Support for sensitive documents protected with Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MPIP)
description: Unblock users from upload files with Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MPIP) sensitivity labels to Copilot Studio agents deployed on the M365 channel. With this support agents can process content based on the user's/agents account permissions, with label protections enforced end-to-end.
